changelog:
白い熊 店 4.8.4+019
• The automation path no longer crashes when it is started cold. A broadcast is a background start on Android 12+, so the foreground service it needs can be refused — and the refusal was killing the app instead of failing the export
• Four places could be refused, not one; the export service's own start had nowhere to send a reply, so a refusal there vanished silently
• A refused start is now reported with a keyed error, so 保存復元 can offer a “battery optimisation” button on the failed row
• That button is only offered when it would actually help: if the app is already exempt, or the state cannot be read, the real reason is reported instead — on EMUI the cause can be アプリ起動管理, which no app can change for itself
• This makes a cold-phone failure diagnosable, not fixed: exempting the app from battery optimisation is what lets a cold export run
